versions.changelog:
- Added explicit mention that this skill is part of the Overpowered skill suite and included a suite_url in metadata.
- Revised the description for clarity; now references its suite and clarifies intended use.
- Updated document title to "Overpowered / Skillify."
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

- Initial release of the skillify Agent Skill packaging workflow.
- Provides clear steps for extracting and generalizing proven workflows into portable Agent Skills.
- Emphasizes evidence-based qualification and precise, minimal instructions.
- Includes guidance on separating reusable methods from project-specific details and on constructing meaningful evals.
- Clearly outlines the boundaries, gotchas, and output package structure for skillification.
